stripped_sentences: The Vancouver Canucks beat the Edmonton Oilers 6-5 in overtime Tuesday at Rogers Place

failed_claims.claim: The Canucks beat the Oilers 6-5 in overtime, with Paul Cotter scoring the winner 1:59 into overtime after Evan Bouchard's hat trick and five points and two goals from Vasily Podkolzin.
failed_claims.episode_span: The Vancouver Canucks beat the Edmonton Oilers 6-5 in overtime Tuesday at Rogers Place
failed_claims.supporting_quote: In overtime, Paul Cotter scored his second goal of the evening 1:59 into the extra frame to give Edmonton’s Pacific Division rivals the victory and spoil Tuesday’s Home Opener.

claims.claim: Fundraisers hit a $3 million target for an MRI at Dawson Creek's new hospital, described as the first publicly funded MRI in B.C.'s South Peace.
claims.episode_span: fundraisers have hit a $3 million target for an MRI at the city's new hospital
claims.source_title: Fundraisers hit $3M target in push for public MRI in Dawson Creek, B.C.
claims.supporting_quote: The Dawson Creek and District Hospital Foundation says an MRI machine for the city's new hospital will be the first publicly-funded MRI in B.C.'s South Peace region, where patients travel long distances and face long waitlists for diagnostic services.

claims.claim: The Transportation Safety Board found a series of gaps behind a 2024 tugboat-workboat collision at the Woodfibre LNG site near Squamish that sank one vessel.
claims.episode_span: a series of gaps behind a 2024 collision between a tugboat and a workboat at the Woodfibre LNG site near Squamish
claims.source_title: Boat collision at Woodfibre LNG site near Squamish was due to safety gaps, TSB finds
claims.supporting_quote: Canada's Transportation Safety Board has found a series of gaps leading to a crash between a tugboat and a workboat in 2024, sinking one of the vessels in the waters near Squamish, B.C.

claims.claim: The B.C. Conservation Officer Service warned of increased grizzly sightings on the Sunshine Coast, linked to a poor berry crop and a larger bear population in Pender Harbour, Madeira Park and Sechelt.
claims.episode_span: warning of increased grizzly bear sightings on the Sunshine Coast
claims.source_title: B.C. Conservation Officer Service warns of increased grizzly bear sightings on Sunshine Coast
claims.supporting_quote: Poor berry crop and increase in bear population linked to reports in Pender Harbour, Madeira Park and Sechelt communities

claims.episode_span: B.C. home sales and prices edged higher in August
claims.source_title: Bryan Yu: B.C. housing market recovery gains ground despite Interior wildfires, rate pressures
claims.supporting_quote: B.C. home sales and prices edged higher in August while wildfires disrupted Interior markets

claims.claim: After David Eby called a snap election, municipal and provincial elections in B.C. fall a week apart, and public administration experts say overlapping campaigns give voters a lot to track.
claims.episode_span: municipal and provincial elections a week apart
claims.source_title: The difference between local governments and the provincial government in B.C.
claims.supporting_quote: After B.C. NDP Leader David Eby called a snap election, voters in B.C. are preparing for elections at both the municipal and provincial level — just a week apart.

claims.claim: Dollarton Highway on-ramps in both directions are closed for paving from Sunday October 4 until Monday October 5, with stated detours.
claims.episode_span: paving closures on the Dollarton Highway on-ramps, eastbound and westbound, from Sunday, October 4 until Monday, October 5
claims.source_title: DriveBC: 8 major road events in Metro Vancouver
claims.supporting_quote: Paving operations from Dollarton Highway Onramp, Eastbound Dollarton Onramp to Eastbound Dollarton Onramp. Starting Sun Oct 4 until Mon Oct 5. Closed. Detour in effect. Eastbound take Riverside Drive to Mount Seymour Parkway to Keith Road interchange.

claims.claim: Environment Canada lists no watches or warnings, a Wednesday high of 15 except 18 inland, a Wednesday night low of 9, and a Thursday high of 16 except 19 inland.
claims.supporting_quote: Wednesday: Mainly cloudy. Clearing late this morning. Fog patches dissipating this morning. High 15 except 18 inland. UV index 4 or moderate.

claims.claim: Tristan Jarry made 17 saves on 23 shots, and the teams rematch Thursday at Rogers Arena.
claims.episode_span: Tristan Jarry made 17 saves on 23 shots.
claims.supporting_quote: The Oilers will rematch the Canucks on the road this Thursday at Rogers Arena.

claims.claim: A B.C. judge dropped drug charges against a Vancouver compassion club and ruled the Controlled Drug and Substance Act unconstitutional because it prevents access to a safe supply, with the ruling on hold for six months.
claims.episode_span: dropped drug charges against a Vancouver compassion club and ruled the Controlled Drug and Substance Act unconstitutional
claims.source_title: B.C. judge drops drug charges against Vancouver compassion club, declares law illegal
claims.supporting_quote: Supreme Court ruling is put on hold for six months to allow federal government to change Controlled Drug and Substance Act, which it ruled is unconstitutional because it prevents drug users from accessing safe supply

claims.claim: A B.C. Supreme Court judge tossed drug-trafficking convictions against two harm reduction activists who argued they acted to reduce harms from toxic drugs.
claims.episode_span: tossed drug-trafficking convictions against two harm reduction activists
claims.source_title: Judge tosses drug trafficking convictions for B.C. compassion club founders after constitutional challenge
claims.supporting_quote: A B.C. Supreme Court judge has ruled in favour of two harm reduction activists convicted of drug trafficking who argued they were doing it to reduce the harms caused by toxic drugs.
